reviews.t: Good Waxing Kit

This was should last me a long time as I'm only planning on using it for eyebrows. The only problem I had was a string (picture pizza cheese when you pull it from the box) would sometimes come along and I had to quickly wipe it off before I lost more hair than intended. It was a little struggle but still, the kit is worth it in the long run. The wax held the hair and pulled off in one pu

reviews.t: Plastic Jar Melted
reviews.x: I'd give it zero stars if I could. I've used several other microwavable wax brands before without issue. I have had overflow in the microwave if I out it in for too long but usually only a drip. The instructions said to put it in for three minutes, I put it in for two. The jar melted and the entire wax contents went all over my microwave. Now I have to purchase a new microwave dish because there is no getting this stuff off. This is a waste of money and a hazzard.

reviews.t: Works perfect
reviews.x: This works perfect.  The wax melts at a low temp so you don't have to burn yourself.  Start with LESS time than the instructions say, though.  Mine was too hot when I went by the suggested time.

reviews.t: So Convenient! Feels professional grade
reviews.x: I needed this so bad for my eyebrows. I'm on social media, but keep incognito here. And I'm a makeup artist and own a business. I'm constantly shopping for the BEST; the BEST quality, the BEST price!  And this is just fantastic! The ease in using it, just pop it in the microwave and wax away. The wax is strong, it feels professional grade, and, it's so convenient. Buying again once it's done!

reviews.t: Its fine
reviews.x: I used it on my eyebrows and chin. It picked up most hair off my eyebrow area. And it wasn't strong enough to pull off any of the hair off my chin area. Overall, the wax was not strong enough for deep hairs but would be fine for eyebrows.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the wax works well and removes hair effectively, especially for eyebrows and facial hair.
Several reviewers warn that the microwave instructions overheat the wax, so it should be heated for less time than directed.
Some reviewers report the wax is stringy or messy to work with and takes getting used to.
A few reviewers had negative skin reactions or found the wax too weak for coarse hair.
Some reviewers experienced packaging or melting problems, including a melted jar and a broken handle causing leaks.
